in_marathi.name: Triveni
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Confluence of three rivers
in_marathi.long_meaning: Triveni हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Triveni is a name of divine significance in Hindu mythology, representing the confluence of three sacred rivers - Ganga, Yamuna, and Saraswati. It symbolizes the union of the physical and spiritual worlds, purification, and the attainment of moksha.

vedic_reference.note: The name Triveni is derived from the three sacred rivers - the Ganga, Yamuna, and the Saraswati. In Hindu mythology, Triveni is considered to be the place where these three rivers converge. It is also believed that taking a dip in the Triveni River absolves one of all their sins.
